thread:
caroline: Quick coordinated ask for partners: finance needs a normalized payload that covers reserved vs spot economics, eviction behavior, and release/penalty matrices. Goal: one CSV + optional time-series link. Need responses next Tue.

diego: Suggest two tiers of asks: minimal (must-have) and extended (nice-to-have). Minimal should let us compute effective $/token for inference runs.

mike: Minimal fields I care about: sku_id, vendor, region, instance_type, gpu_model, reserved_price_per_hour_usd, reserved_term_months, reserved_guaranteed_pct, reserved_release_allowed(true/false), reserved_release_penalty_usd, spot_p10_usd, spot_p50_usd, spot_p90_usd, spot_time_series_link, eviction_pct_per_day, eviction_notice_seconds, eviction_credit_scheme(hourly_credit|monthly_rebate|invoice_adj), eviction_credit_value, min_running_seconds_for_credit, billing_granularity_seconds, timezone.

tanya: Extended fields: volume_discount_breakpoints (CSV link or inline), marketplace_listing_fee_pct, marketplace_per_invoice_fee_usd, channel_partner_fee_pct, sla_backed_latency_p50_ms, availability_windows (human readable).

samir: Ops asks: if reserved_release_allowed=true, also provide a penalty_curve link (CSV: units_released, penalty_usd). If reserved is pinned to private racks include pinned_capacity_units. For eviction inputs, percentiles (p50,p95) of notice_seconds are more useful than single median.

caroline: Example single-row we can paste (compact): sku-elm-02,Stratus,us-west-2,p4d.24xlarge,A100-80GB,12.00,12,98,true,15000,3.20,1.8,3.0,6.5,https://s3.example.com/stratus/spot_14d.csv,0.4,240,hourly_credit,20,300,60,UTC

diego: Request partners to label whether eviction_credit_value is percent or USD depending on scheme. Also ask partners to state whether credits are auto-applied or require claim with evidence type.

mike: For spot history, prefer csv with two cols (iso8601, price_usd). 7 days minimum; 14 preferred. If only percentiles available supply p5/p25/p50/p75/p95.

tanya: Legal note: ask partners to confirm they can provide redacted eviction proof (eviction_id, timestamp, instance_sku) in a format we can automate against. If they cannot, ask for a manual reconciliation process description.

samir: I'll create a small ingestion lambda to validate partner CSVs once we get them. Two operational checks: timezone parseable and billing_granularity in seconds.

partner-bot: Upload: outreach/templates/hw_pricing_commit_release_matrix_v1.csv :white_check_mark:

caroline: Thanks all. I'll post the outreach copy and the required CSV header (minimal + extended columns) in #partners-drafts in 30m. We'll triage responses at Wed sync. :white_check_mark:
